sheets.name: characters
sheets.description: Playable characters. One row per character swapped in.

rows.model_source: player's own Half-Life 2 install (its model files), converted on the player's PC
rows.skeleton_target: Sonic's rig in SA2 (animations must map onto it)
rows.notes: Movement (run, jump, grind) stays exactly as Sonic's. Only the look, the attack and the sounds change. Open: Sonic's jump is a spin-ball pose. Decide Gordon's jump pose with the user.

sheets.name: attacks
sheets.description: Moves that change. One row per move.

rows.trigger_input: same button as the replaced move
rows.effect_on_enemy: defeats the enemy in one hit, using the game's existing Homing Attack hit logic
rows.notes: User delegated the choice; recommended Homing Attack because it is the stage's main enemy-killing move. Version 1 aim: keep the game's lock-on movement and hit data, swap only Gordon's swing animation and the HL2 sounds. Agent must confirm this is feasible in the running game.

sheets.name: enemies
sheets.description: SA2's own City Escape enemies stay as they are (user choice); Gordon fights them. One row per enemy type found in the stage.

rows.notes: Enumerate from the stage's object placement data and add one row per enemy type. Do not invent names.

sheets.name: sounds
sheets.description: Half-Life 2 sounds and music for the stage. Every candidate path must be checked against the real VPK contents.

sheets.name: hooks
sheets.description: Places where the mod touches the game. Targets are unknown until the game files are inspected; never guess an address or file name.

rows.value: Run City Escape as Gordon Freeman, crowbar in hand.
Sonic Adventure 2's City Escape, starring Gordon Freeman. Run down the stage as Gordon, swing a crowbar through the robots, and hear Half-Life 2's sounds and music along the way. Single player.
Valve (Half-Life 2); Sega / Sonic Team (Sonic Adventure 2); the authors of the SA2 Mod Loader / SA Mod Manager; the mod's author (my Melty account name unless I say otherwise)
MIT, for the mod's own code only. Valve and Sega content stays theirs and is not included.

asset_route: decided: Gordon's look and the HL2 sounds/music are read from the player's own Half-Life 2 install. No Valve files ship in the release.
build_status: decided: no build exists yet. The coding agent builds and tests it on the user's PC. Everything is design-only until then.
